description: ONLY on request. Draws the character in their own place doing what they usually do (an idle moment), using concept.png as the character reference. Saves scene.png — the first and last frame for character_video. Write a specific prompt from the card (location, idle pose, light) or omit it for a default.

notes.description: Corrections for this take, in plain words (e.g. 'his height must read against the ceiling', 'hands stay off the barometer', 'no smoke'). They go first as binding rules and win over the default prompt. Use this to fix a result instead of rewriting the whole prompt.

prompt.description: The scene: place, what they are doing, pose, light, framing. Keep the character exactly as in the reference.

name: character_scene
title: Character in their environment (still)
